title: What attention actually computes
description: How a transformer works out what the word 'it' refers to: queries, keys and values, the dot product, and why attention is a soft search that can be trained.

title: How LLMs watch video: beyond sampling frames
description: Why the default is one frame per second, and the ideas that go beyond frame sampling: tokens that span time, pruning what did not move, reading the video codec, timestamps, audio, streaming and agentic viewing.
